taxonomy_policy.principle: Objective acoustic sound events only. Reject subjective distress/assault interpretations.
taxonomy_policy.safety_rule: Audio cue is purely advisory. requires_user_confirmation must always be true. Never auto-trigger SOS.

target_classes.name: background_normal
target_classes.description: Standard ambient urban environment sounds, human conversation, laughter, footsteps, quiet streets, traffic hum, engine idling, wind.

target_classes.name: screaming_shouting
target_classes.description: High-intensity vocal acoustic events: human screams, loud shouts, aggressive vocal calls.

target_classes.name: alarm_siren
target_classes.description: Audible alert systems: emergency vehicle sirens, police sirens, ambulance sirens, car alarms, repetitive horn blasts.

target_classes.name: glass_breaking
target_classes.description: High-frequency shatter and impact sounds characteristic of breaking glass panes, windows, bottles.

target_classes.name: impact_crash
target_classes.description: Abrupt high-energy mechanical impact: vehicular collisions, metal crushing, heavy structural impact.
